info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Matching API
info.description: The Product Matching API facilitates the identification and alignment of products within the banking sector to ensure accurate categorization and recommendation. This endpoint supports the matching of relevant products based on criteria provided in requests, enabling businesses to enhance their sales strategies and improve customer engagement. Typical consumers include sales teams and integration partners aiming to streamline product offerings. The API streamlines the process of aligning customer needs with suitable financial products, driving sales efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate the product matching process by submitting relevant product data. The system will analyze the input data and attempt to find matches with existing records, facilitating more accurate sales and inventory management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit product matching data. It should contain information necessary for matching products based on various criteria defined in the schema.
